name: anthill
description: Portable team-OS — installs an ephemeral-agent team (durable seats, coordination over comms + bounty, living docs) into any project. Stigmergy-driven methodology, a Bun CLI, and the bootstrap / convene / plan / join / finalize-session / curate / upgrade lifecycle skills — seats write session reports, a separate curate step turns them into method, and a per-team OKF wiki holds each touch point's how.
